question: The fifth edition of the Khelo India Youth Games were organised in Bhopal city in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2023**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The fifth edition of the **Khelo India Youth Games** was organized in **Bhopal city** in the year **2023**.
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games is a part of the Khelo India programme, which aims to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroots level by building a strong framework for all sports played in our country and establishing India as a great sporting nation.
 
• The event brings together young athletes from across the country to compete in a variety of sports, promoting sportsmanship and the spirit of competition.
 
• Bhopal, the capital city of Madhya Pradesh, played host to the games, providing a platform for young athletes to showcase their talent and compete at a national level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Khelo India programme** was launched by the Government of India in 2018 to promote sports at the grassroots level and identify young talent.
 
• The programme includes various initiatives such as the Khelo India School Games, Khelo India Youth Games, Khelo India University Games, and the Khelo India Winter Games.
 
• It also provides financial assistance to athletes, coaches, and sports infrastructure development.
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games have been instrumental in identifying and nurturing young athletes who have the potential to represent India at international sporting events.
